pretitle: Founded by Adam Smith, Jeff Bonforte and Matt Brezina
subtitle: Xobni (the word 'inbox' spelled backwards) was a San Francisco-based company founded in 2006 that aimed to make your inbox and contacts list less terrible by focusing on the people you communicate with most.

name: Y42
pretitle: Founded by Hung Dang
subtitle: Founded in 2020 and based in Berlin, Y42 is the full-stack data platform that anyone can run. Founder Hung Dang set up the company following experiences working in start-ups and data consulting where he encountered organisations suffering from the same data pain points time and again. The Y42 team works to develop an industry-agnostic data platform that solves issues of managing complex data stacks once and for all.

name: Zapp
pretitle: Founded by Navid Hadzaad and Joe Falter
subtitle: Zapp is building the ‘need it now’ supply chain of the future with its mission to delight customers with things that make them happy, the moment they need it. The 24/7 convenience app lets you order everyday items on-demand, including last-minute snacks, drinks, and essential groceries.
description:
Zapp provides on-demand delivery services. It is building the future of convenience with a full-stack approach to on-demand essential items, 24/7, delivered in minutes. It is backed by the world's leading investors, and our team has scale-up and exit experience at companies such as Amazon, Jumia, Deliveroo, Tesco, Stuart, and Just Eat.

The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Kent, United Kingdom.

name: Zocdoc
pretitle: Founded by Oliver Kharraz, Nick Ganju and Cyrus Massoumi
subtitle: Zocdoc is the leading digital healthcare marketplace for in-person or virtual care.
description:
Zocdoc is a technology company that provides a better healthcare experience for millions of patients every month. Its online marketplace delivers the accessible, seamless, and simple experience patients expect and deserve.

Zocdoc was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in New York.
